ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-grey) surface area comprising approximately 85% of visible pixels, contrasted by low-intensity (dark-grey/black) edge regions and focal markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity zone across the central fluke body. Distinct low-intensity geometric blobs located at [x=0.15, y=0.35] and [x=0.20, y=0.55] on the left lobe. Elongated low-intensity banding along the entire trailing edge perimeter with increased density on the right lobe distal region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep symmetric V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees and a vertex depth reaching 15% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-amplitude serration pattern across both lobes. Features multiple primary peaks and deep jagged valleys, particularly on the outer third of each lobe where pixel deviation from the mean edge-line exceeds 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the median notch towards the terminal tips, terminating in acute-angled points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of low-intensity pixels at both the extreme left and right terminal tips. Small circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosette-like) are visible on the mid-medial surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple near-vertical dark linear streaks extending from the trailing edge inward on the right lobe. One horizontal linear disruption of natural pigment mapping is visible on the left lobe near the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and traumatic loss of tissue along the trailing edge. A distinctive vertical dark linear mark extends downward from the vertex of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-intensity white pixel speckling (spray/water droplets) concentrated at the inferior boundary where the fluke meets the water surface.
